name: Grand Central Wiring
old_description: Our mission is to make the process of selecting and installing your electronics effortless so you can focus on enjoying them. Whether you desire speakers on your terrace, a television located above your home fireplace or in your office lobby, several remote controls combined into one, or your own custom idea brought to reality, Grand Central Wiring ensures that your experience will be superior. We offer a variety of services customized to your needs.
about:
Grand Central Wiring was founded in 2006 by Jason Gillespie in Greenville, South Carolina. The company began as an audio/video design and installation firm, later expanding into security, automation, and structured wiring services for both residential and commercial clients.

Today the business provides a full range of technology integration services, including TV mounting, custom home theater design, universal remote programming, distributed audio, network and structured wiring, video surveillance, smart home automation, lighting control, and electrical wiring. It also offers construction-related services such as sheetrock repair, painting, framing, and masonry to support design-build cinema projects. The team works on new construction and retrofit projects across the Upstate region.

Clients include homeowners, business owners, and home builders. Grand Central Wiring wires for all major local TV and internet providers—Charter, AT&T, DirecTV, and Dish—and collaborates with licensed builder Phil Gillespie on design-build cinema installations. The company serves both residential and commercial spaces, from private home theaters to office lobby displays.

The firm emphasizes simplifying the purchase and installation process, offering free estimates, a satisfaction guarantee, and an extended warranty on products sold through them. With more than 20 years of combined experience in electrical and low-voltage work, the company positions its expertise in solving difficult installation challenges as its primary differentiator.
